text-1mib.why: 1 MiB of paragraphs, 264 pages: the account holds about 49 MiB at its peak.

text-4mib.why: 4 MiB of paragraphs, about 1,050 pages: the account holds about 200 MiB at its peak, the Go heap about 390 MiB.

text-16mib.why: 16 MiB of paragraphs, the default input cap, about 4,200 pages: the account holds about 790 MiB at its peak, under the 1 GiB budget, and the process about 1.6 GiB.

html-1mib.why: 1 MiB of paragraphs, 257 pages: the account holds about 170 MiB at its peak, the Go heap about 340 MiB.

html-4mib.why: 4 MiB of paragraphs, about 1,025 pages: the account holds about 690 MiB at its peak, the process about 1.5 GiB.

html-16mib.why: 16 MiB of paragraphs: the styles, boxes, shaped paragraphs and glyph runs would hold about 2.7 GiB, and the budget refuses them during the layout, under a second in; the process peaks near 1.2 GiB.

html-png-10.why: Ten distinct 12-megapixel PNGs: each is held decoded, 48 MB, only while it is encoded, then its compressed samples go to the conversion's picture file past 8 MiB; the account peaks near 55 MiB, the process near 280 MiB.

html-png-50.why: Fifty distinct 12-megapixel PNGs, 2.4 GB of pixels decoded one at a time, their compressed samples kept in the conversion's picture file past 8 MiB: the account peaks near 65 MiB and the Go heap near 230 MiB, where both held the samples, 310 MiB, before.

html-jpeg-10.why: Ten distinct 12-megapixel JPEGs, written as they are: their files are charged, no pixel is decoded.

html-jpeg-50.why: Fifty distinct 12-megapixel JPEGs, written as they are: the first 8 MiB of their files are held and charged, the rest wait in the conversion's picture file; no pixel is decoded.

csv-100k.why: 100,000 cells, 182 pages: the account holds about 180 MiB at its peak, the Go heap about 270 MiB.

csv-1000k.why: 1,000,000 cells, the cap: each cell is charged what the pages built from it cost when it is read, so the budget refuses the workbook while it is read, before any page is planned.

docx-2000pages.why: 2,000 pages of one paragraph each: the account holds about 160 MiB at its peak, the Go heap about 370 MiB.
